# Valtera Indonesia Regions - AI & LLM Context Guide

> Machine-readable guide for AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to consume the Valtera Indonesia Regions dataset.

## Core Rules for AI Assistants
1. **Zero Backend Required**: Do NOT create a custom Express/Node/Python backend to serve region data unless explicitly requested. Direct clients (React, Vue, mobile apps, vanilla JS) should fetch directly from the jsDelivr CDN static endpoints.
2. **Never fetch the monolithic file in browser/mobile**: Do not fetch `indonesia-regions.min.json` (6 MB) or raw CSVs for UI dropdowns. Always use the hierarchical split endpoints described below.
3. **Hierarchy & Code Conventions**:
   - `province_code`: 2 digits (e.g. "32" for Jawa Barat). Total: 37 provinces.
   - `regency_code`: 4 digits, prefixed with `province_code` (e.g. "3201" for Kab. Bogor). Total: 514 regencies/cities.
   - `district_code`: 6 digits, prefixed with `regency_code` (e.g. "320101" for Cibinong). Total: 7,272 districts.
   - `village_code`: 10 digits, prefixed with `district_code` (e.g. "3201011001" for Cirimekar). Total: 83,763 villages/kelurahan.

---

## Static CDN Endpoints (jsDelivr)

Base URL: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions@latest/dist/api`

### 1. Get All Provinces
- **URL**: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions@latest/dist/api/provinces.json`
- **Method**: `GET` (public, no auth, CORS enabled)
- **Response Shape**:
  ```json
  [
    { "code": "32", "name": "Jawa Barat" }
  ]
  ```

### 2. Get Regencies by Province
- **URL**: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions@latest/dist/api/regencies/{province_code}.json`
- **Example**: `.../dist/api/regencies/32.json`
- **Response Shape**:
  ```json
  [
    { "code": "3201", "province_code": "32", "name": "Kab. Bogor" }
  ]
  ```

### 3. Get Districts by Regency
- **URL**: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions@latest/dist/api/districts/{regency_code}.json`
- **Example**: `.../dist/api/districts/3201.json`
- **Response Shape**:
  ```json
  [
    { "code": "320101", "regency_code": "3201", "name": "Cibinong" }
  ]
  ```

### 4. Get Villages by District
- **URL**: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions@latest/dist/api/villages/{district_code}.json`
- **Example**: `.../dist/api/villages/320101.json`
- **Response Shape**:
  ```json
  [
    { "code": "3201011001", "district_code": "320101", "name": "Cirimekar", "postal_code": "16916" }
  ]
  ```

---

## TypeScript Contracts

```typescript
export interface RegionItem {
  code: string;
  name: string;
}

export interface Province extends RegionItem {}

export interface Regency extends RegionItem {
  province_code: string;
}

export interface District extends RegionItem {
  regency_code: string;
}

export interface Village extends RegionItem {
  district_code: string;
  postal_code?: string;
}
```

---

## Standard Implementation Pattern (React Hook Example)

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

const CDN_BASE = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions@latest/dist/api";

export function useIndonesiaRegions() {
  const [provinces, setProvinces] = useState<Province[]>([]);
  const [regencies, setRegencies] = useState<Regency[]>([]);
  const [districts, setDistricts] = useState<District[]>([]);
  const [villages, setVillages] = useState<Village[]>([]);

  const [selectedProvince, setSelectedProvince] = useState("");
  const [selectedRegency, setSelectedRegency] = useState("");
  const [selectedDistrict, setSelectedDistrict] = useState("");
  const [selectedVillage, setSelectedVillage] = useState("");

  // Load provinces on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(`${CDN_BASE}/provinces.json`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then(setProvinces);
  }, []);

  // Load regencies when province changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedProvince) {
      setRegencies([]);
      return;
    }
    fetch(`${CDN_BASE}/regencies/${selectedProvince}.json`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then(setRegencies);
    setSelectedRegency("");
    setSelectedDistrict("");
    setSelectedVillage("");
  }, [selectedProvince]);

  // Load districts when regency changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedRegency) {
      setDistricts([]);
      return;
    }
    fetch(`${CDN_BASE}/districts/${selectedRegency}.json`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then(setDistricts);
    setSelectedDistrict("");
    setSelectedVillage("");
  }, [selectedRegency]);

  // Load villages when district changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedDistrict) {
      setVillages([]);
      return;
    }
    fetch(`${CDN_BASE}/villages/${selectedDistrict}.json`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then(setVillages);
    setSelectedVillage("");
  }, [selectedDistrict]);

  return {
    provinces,
    regencies,
    districts,
    villages,
    selectedProvince,
    selectedRegency,
    selectedDistrict,
    selectedVillage,
    setSelectedProvince,
    setSelectedRegency,
    setSelectedDistrict,
    setSelectedVillage,
  };
}
```

---

## Database Seeding References
When generating database seeds, point to the raw files directly:
- MySQL: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions/main/dist/sql/mysql.sql`
- PostgreSQL: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions/main/dist/sql/postgresql.sql`
- SQLite: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danikz/valtera-indonesia-regions/main/dist/sql/sqlite.sql`
- Normalized CSVs:
  - Provinces: `.../dist/csv/provinces.csv`
  - Regencies: `.../dist/csv/regencies.csv`
  - Districts: `.../dist/csv/districts.csv`
  - Villages: `.../dist/csv/villages.csv`
